leastWorthwhile.text: Making clouds was clear but predictable, especially as it was the only offered combination.

arbitrary.text: Gravity turning clouds into rain felt somewhat simplified, though the result explained that droplets grow and fall.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how water accumulates and changes the young coast, though the mostly forced choices made this chapter straightforward.
